tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Assess whether a prospect is a fit for forward-deployed AI engineering, honestly. Fit is set by the workflow and budget, not company size, and includes the pharma/biotech exclusion.

workflow.description: The operational workflow they want to improve.

has_workflow_owner.description: Is there a person who owns the workflow and can make decisions?

data_reachable.description: Is the relevant data reachable (in systems that can be accessed)?

operating_business.description: Is this an established operating business with real operational volume and budget, not a pre-revenue idea?

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Retrieve one Pixelik article by slug: its title, summary, topic, URL, and FAQ answers.

slug.description: The article slug, for example what-is-forward-deployed-ai-engineering.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: The two ways a person can book a Workflow Audit. Share these links with the person; they complete the booking themselves behind a bot check. Never book on a person's behalf.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Live systems Pixelik has built and runs, as proof.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Pixelik's engagement model and what each phase delivers. Pricing is not public.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Pixelik's writing on forward-deployed AI engineering, production AI, agents, automation, and buying AI. Returns matching articles with titles, summaries, and URLs.

query.description: Keywords or a question to search for.
